newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: National Irish lends over 1.0 bln punts.
newsitem.headline: National Irish lends over 1.0 bln punts.

text.p: Irish banking group National Irish Bank (NIB) on Thursday said its customer lending breached one billion Irish pounds for the first time in the bank's history.

NIB, a unit of the National Australia Bank, said in a results statement that lending grew 23 percent or 0.7 million Irish pounds since March 1996, breaching the 1.0 billion pound mark for the first time.

"These results reflect the intense organic development currently going on within the Bank. We have increased the scale and pace of development resulting in a higher than average increase in overheads," chief operations officer Philip Halpin said.
Halpin said the benefits of investment in the bank's service base and physical infrastructure were evident in the strong growth in customer lending, deposits and total assets.
National Irish reported a rise of more than six percent in pre-tax profit to 11.9 million Irish pounds for the six months to March 31, 1997.
